title: Garrus Vakarian's rooftop promise in Mass Effect 3
subject: garrus
description:
What does Garrus mean to your Shepard? 👇

Garrus Vakarian in the Reaper war, from burning Palaven to the Citadel rooftop. Spoilers for Mass Effect 3.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by BioWare or Electronic Arts. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: In 2186, the Reapers came for Garrus Vakarian's home world.
Palaven was burning when Shepard found him on Menae, its moon, fighting beside the turian army.
He had warned his people about the Reapers for months. Now the Hierarchy wanted his advice.
Later, on a Citadel rooftop, he and Shepard held a contest shooting bottles off a ledge.
That's where Garrus said the line fans still quote: there is no Shepard without Vakarian.
Three games earlier, he was a frustrated C-Sec officer. Now he would follow Shepard into London.
